spec.name: Orange Kitchen Mature onion Crop
spec.description: A ripe golden onion with a stepped, rounded exposed bulb, papery shoulders, short roots and eight airy tubular green leaves. Tall central spears and outward-bending older leaves create a recognizable onion silhouette. Rooted at y0 with no soil or pot.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. A mature planted onion crop with botanically recognizable growth: appropriate leaves/stems, ripe edible parts and realistic species-specific plant silhouette in Minecraft cuboids. Airy gaps, layered leaf shapes, leaf veins, natural plant clusters. NOT a generic tomato bush recolored. Rooted at y0, x2..14,z2..14,y0..16. No pot or dirt block. All growth-stage variants will be based on this model.
